funding.raw: Insights counts each 1-minute DOWN bucket in `monitor_health_history` as its own outage.

admission.agent_reason: Unpriced repository-owner incident (founder wound). The issue is authored by fiztoz (author_association=OWNER) and announces a real production-impacting defect in the uptime-phoenix Insights outage counting: every 1-minute DOWN bucket in monitor_health_history is counted as a separate outage, inflating counts (459 outages for one 7-hour outage). It is bounded to one defect in applyOverallProjection in internal/core/services/insights_projection.go, with reproduction steps, expected/actual behavior, and an exact code pointer. Funding is the owner's own issue (no amount/currency; is_founder_wound). No competing open PR (gh pr list --search "198 in:body" empty, no open PRs). The repository actively merges work via pull requests. Issue updated 2026-11-02, not stale.
admission.scope_quote: The fix is to count only when entering DOWN, or to merge adjacent same-status intervals first.
